agentContract.composition: Import named components from @spfx-fast/sharepoint-ui/react. Put one SharePointUIProvider around the view. Compose with children by default; use only the slots and component props listed for that component.
agentContract.state: State props, initial default props, callback names, and callback arguments vary by component. Follow that component's signature and callbackProps; update controlled state in its callback.
agentContract.customElements: Import the component's define function from @spfx-fast/sharepoint-ui/elements/{module} and register it once. Set objects and callbacks as DOM properties. For event names and statically visible detail keys, use the source module's event inventory at https://vystartasv.github.io/sharepoint-ui/agents/events/{module}.json; it is module-scoped, so check event.target when composed tags emit events.

elementEventInventory.scope: source module; composed child tags may also emit listed events

api.reactSignature: { children, selectedValue, defaultSelectedValue, selectedValues, defaultSelectedValues, selectionMode = "single", layout = "grid", size = "medium", shape = "square", spacing = "medium", focusMode = "arrow", columns = 6, onSelectionChange, ...props }: SwatchPickerProps

relatedReactApis.name: useSavedSwatchPalettes(store)
relatedReactApis.description: Load, save, remove, and refresh named palettes through a stable host-owned store. Use the app's SharePoint data service for tenant-wide persistence; the hook adds no network or storage dependency. See the saved palettes guide for a complete React recipe.

relatedReactApis.name: SwatchPaletteStore
relatedReactApis.description: Implement list, save, and remove with the app's current persistence service. Keep the store object stable across React renders.

relatedReactApis.name: SavedSwatchPalette
relatedReactApis.description: A named palette record with an id and color entries containing value, color, and optional label.

relatedReactApis.name: SharePointThemeSwatches
relatedReactApis.description: Compose inside SwatchPicker to render every color in the nearest SharePointUIProvider theme palette. Pass palette to override the provider palette, or labelForColor to localize accessible color names.

relatedReactApis.name: getSharePointThemeColorPresets(palette, labelForKey?)
relatedReactApis.description: Framework-neutral helper that maps every non-empty SharePoint palette entry, including custom tenant keys, to named swatch data.

relatedReactApis.name: SharePointThemeColorPreset
relatedReactApis.description: A named palette key, controlled value, CSS color, and accessible label.

component.summary: Render accessible color and image swatches as a keyboard-operable single- or multi-selection grid or row.
